name: Chikuzen (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chikuzen town emblem in green, blue and red: a green stylised figure with a blue ring and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Chikuzen, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Chikuzen town emblem — a green stylised figure with a blue ring and a red disc
